description.value: The Francis Boutique Inn is an adult-only luxury boutique hotel perched on a private half-acre treed hillside in the heart of Ucluelet, with individual private outdoor entrances for each suite and harbour views. Named after Captain Peter Francis, an original pioneer of the Ucluth Peninsula, it was voted #1 Small Hotel in Canada in 2019. Its central location puts guests within a one-minute walk of restaurants, a grocery store, cafes, a bakery, and the harbour-front — a convenient base for rides along the Wild Pacific Trail and into Pacific Rim National Park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active boutique hotel at 1536 Peninsula Rd, Ucluelet, matching OSM address and website URL. The phone number differs between OSM (+1-250-600-1750) and the website (1-236-600-1750), flagged as a concern. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site; the website does explicitly confirm free fiber-optic Wi-Fi per suite, and walking-distance restaurants, cafes, bakery, grocery store, and brewery.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-250-600-1750 but the website consistently shows 1-236-600-1750 (different area code). Website value used.
Website suite pages repeatedly display 'Coming Soon In Summer 2023' banners, suggesting web content may not have been fully updated since 2023.
Property is adult-only; may exclude family cycling groups.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active boutique accommodation in a prime cycling area, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is confirmed anywhere on the website. Direct outreach is needed before listing.
